name: R1
certifies: every prime factor p < 2^54 of every F_n with n >= 12

name: R2a
certifies: every prime factor k*2^m+1 (k odd <= 65535, 14 <= m <= 1000) of F_n, n >= 12

name: R2b
certifies: every prime factor k*2^m+1 (k odd <= 4095, 1001 <= m <= 3000) of F_n, n >= 12

name: R2c
note: k in [65537, 1048575]; union with R2a gives all odd k <= 2^20-1
